title: Maximal Marginal Relevance
signature: def mmr(query: np.ndarray, docs: np.ndarray, k: int, lam: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray
hints: Precompute the cosine similarity of every doc to the query, and the doc-doc cosine similarity matrix.
Keep a running array max_sim[j] = max similarity of doc j to anything already selected. It starts at 0 and only needs a np.maximum update after each pick.
Score = lam * rel - (1 - lam) * max_sim. Mask already-selected docs with -inf before np.argmax, which picks the lowest index on ties.
